name: EXTR01 safety set
note: Safety questions (P22g, 2026-11-08). Answers from the approved Safety facts (P22d review, P27d batches) and their manual pages. `abstain`: the part has no safety notice in the library; the right answer says so and invents no step. `forbid`: steps or PPE a wrong answer would invent.

questions.question: I need to open the cutter drive right after stopping it. Is that safe?
questions.answer: No: wait 5 minutes for the capacitors to discharge, then check the voltage at the converter connections (WARNING)
questions.source: SINAMICS G120C Operating Instructions, p.15, p.419

questions.question: What do I have to watch for when lifting the cutter motor?
questions.answer: Use the designated hoisting points / all the lifting eyes, suitable lifting equipment, strap guiding or spreading devices

questions.question: What PPE do I need to work on the water dosing pump?
questions.answer: Protective clothing, gloves and safety goggles (chemical exposure from the dosing medium, WARNING)
questions.source: Grundfos SMART Digital DDA instructions, p.4

questions.question: Is the laser on the product discharge infrared thermometer dangerous?
questions.answer: WARNING: do not point the laser at the eyes of persons or animals, do not stare into the beam, avoid reflections

questions.question: What safety functions does the cutter drive have?
questions.answer: Safe Torque Off (STO); also motor overload protection, motor temperature monitoring, DC link overvoltage monitoring

questions.question: Before I work on the main gearbox oil heater, what do I have to do?
questions.answer: De-energize the oil heater and the thermostat (WARNING, electric shock)
questions.source: X..e series gear units Assembly and Operating Instructions, p.73

questions.question: What are the hazards of the steam control valve?
questions.answer: Hot external surface; PTFE fumes if heated (local exhaust ventilation); pressure; moving parts, noise
questions.source: Spira-trol K and L series IM-S24-42, p.4, p.10, p.12

questions.question: What must I do before working inside the main drive cabinet?
questions.answer: Isolate the drive from the supply and all voltage sources; wait 5 minutes for the intermediate circuit capacitors to discharge (DANGER); disconnect external power sources

questions.question: What safety notices apply to the OPC UA server and collector PC?
questions.answer: Not documented: the SER3 mini PC has no manual or product family in the library
questions.note: Replaced 2026-11-08: the first S9 (feeder hopper load cell) has a real CAUTION in the HI 2160 manual; the DGX quoted it correctly.

questions.question: What are the lockout steps for the bulk density system?
questions.answer: Not documented: the BDS bulk density system has no manual in the library
